crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, high-contrast red triangular patch located at the apex of the crown and nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct color transition from the red head patch to the uniform dark gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, alternating black and white transverse bands across the tail rectrices.
